# StrictMode violations the audit accepts, checked by .github/scripts/strictmode_audit.py.
#
# Format: <policy> <violation> <Class.method> [tests=TestClass,OtherTests]   # reason
#   policy     VM or THREAD
#   violation  the StrictMode violation class name
#   site       the deepest frame in SDK main code, anonymous class numbers dropped
#   tests=     optional, the entry only covers violations raised by these test classes
#
# VM policy violations have no entries: every one found so far was fixed. Tests call the SDK on the
# test thread, which stands in for the app's main thread, so THREAD entries are main thread work.

# Init reads the persisted state synchronously.
THREAD DiskReadViolation CountlyStore.<init>                  # SharedPreferences load during init
THREAD DiskWriteViolation CountlyStore.<init>                 # first use creates the shared_prefs directory
THREAD DiskReadViolation CountlyStore.createPreferencesPush   # push SharedPreferences load during init
THREAD DiskReadViolation CountlyStore.anythingSetInStorage    # storage schema check during init
THREAD DiskReadViolation ModuleDeviceId.getUUID               # generated device ID cache read during init

# Native crash dumps left by sdk-native are looked for, sent, and deleted during init.
THREAD DiskReadViolation ModuleCrash.checkForNativeCrashDumps
THREAD DiskWriteViolation ModuleCrash.checkForNativeCrashDumps
THREAD DiskReadViolation ModuleCrash.recordNativeException

# Crash requests are committed synchronously so they survive the process dying right after.
THREAD DiskReadViolation CountlyStore.storageWriteRequestQueue tests=ModuleCrashTests,MigrationHelperTests
THREAD DiskWriteViolation CountlyStore.storageWriteRequestQueue tests=ModuleCrashTests,MigrationHelperTests

# Work the app asks for explicitly, on the thread it calls from.
THREAD DiskReadViolation CountlyStore.esWriteCacheToStorage tests=CountlyStoreExplicitModeTests
THREAD DiskWriteViolation CountlyStore.esWriteCacheToStorage tests=CountlyStoreExplicitModeTests
THREAD DiskReadViolation ModuleUserProfile.setData            # checks the picture path the app provides
THREAD DiskReadViolation CountlyStore.clear                    # halt() and removeInstance() erase the stored data

# These tests open connections on the test thread, the SDK itself does it on its request threads.
THREAD NetworkViolation ConnectionProcessor.urlConnectionForServerRequest tests=ConnectionProcessorTests,ConnectionQueueIntegrationTests,StrictModeTests
THREAD NetworkViolation ConnectionProcessor.urlConnectionForPreflightRequest tests=ConnectionProcessorTests,ConnectionQueueIntegrationTests,StrictModeTests
